prerequisites.label: myCRMSIM offline documentation set
prerequisites.satisfy: Place the offline documentation set at /Users/blackceomacmini/Downloads/openclaw-master-files/mycrmsim, or re-fetch it from https://support.mycrmsim.com and update skills.85-android-sms-system.docsPath in ADVANCED_CONFIG.md if the location differs.

prerequisites.label: Minimum 156 support articles present
prerequisites.satisfy: Confirm `find <docs>/articles -type f -name '*.md' | wc -l` returns at least 156. A short count means the download was incomplete: re-fetch from https://support.mycrmsim.com. The skill answers from the written articles only; a partial set produces partial answers.

prerequisites.label: python3 (article index and manifest parsing)
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Python 3.9 or newer. On macOS: `xcode-select --install` or `brew install python@3.12`. Verify with `python3 --version`.

prerequisites.label: bash (qc and maintenance scripts)
prerequisites.satisfy: bash ships with macOS at /bin/bash. Verify with `bash --version`. The skill's qc script requires bash 3.2 or newer, which stock macOS provides.

prerequisites.label: 660 article images, approximately 788 MB (optional)
prerequisites.satisfy: Optional. Screenshots and GIFs make step-by-step answers far clearer, but every article reads correctly without them. If disk space is tight, skip _assets; the article text still answers. To restore them, copy _assets back from the download, or re-fetch from https://support.mycrmsim.com.

prerequisites.label: myCRMSIM support site (source of truth for re-fetching)
prerequisites.satisfy: No credential needed; the support center is public. Use it only when the local documentation set is missing, short of 156 articles, or older than the live site. Browse to https://support.mycrmsim.com and re-download the article set.
